name: Saltspray Glen
summary: Along Baradin Bay, salt winds sweep across Saltspray Glen, where wild raptors roam the lowland. The glen lies between murloc waters and ancient dwarven ruins.

sections.title: Brine and Claws
sections.body:
At the Wetlands' far northwest, salty spray blows inland from Baradin Bay across Saltspray Glen. Bluegill Marsh and its murloc-haunted waters lie to the south. To the east, the quiet bluffs of Ironbeard's Tomb rise above the lowland.

Cunning wild raptors nest in the marshy grass and hunt across the brackish flats. Their kin range nearby at Raptor Ridge and Black Channel Marsh, leaving little comfort for travelers passing through.

faq.q: Why is it called Saltspray Glen?
faq.answer: Saltspray Glen lies along the open coast of Baradin Bay. Fierce winds from the north and west drive seawater inland across the low ground as a dense, salty mist.

faq.q: What creatures live in Saltspray Glen?
faq.answer: Aggressive wild raptors overrun the glen, nesting in its coastal brush and marshy hollows. They readily ambush anyone who wanders off the beaten path.

Saltspray Glen lies in the Wetlands' northwestern reaches. Baradin Bay borders it to the north and west. Bluegill Marsh and its murlocs lie to the south, while the rocky rise of Ironbeard's Tomb stands to the east.

angles.text: As a hunter, you find vicious raptors prowling the glen's damp sea grass. They make hearty quarry and fierce, dependable beasts for trackers stalking the coast.
